research_venue.Native_Map_Query: Parco delle Cascine (Cascine Park), Florence, Italy
research_venue.Description: Parco delle Cascine is a major public park on Florence's Arno, and two independently archived cruising directories mention it. CruisingGays points towards Via della Catena and the riverbank; Gays-Cruising has a separate park-side description. Unlike most unverified entries, multiple comments on 16 May 2026 describe an evening crowd and encounters lasting into the night, including one personal statement calling it a favored spot. These are recent user reports, not independently confirmed headcounts or permission for public sex.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Large city park with public shared paths and events. Municipal park information confirms general use, while local police and safety operations have covered parts of Cascine; avoid treating nighttime reports as lawful permission or general safety guarantee.

research_venue.Name: Parco San Donato
research_venue.Description: Parco San Donato in Novoli is a public family-and-neighborhood park in northern Florence. The original directory entry associates it with cruising, but its July 2025 visitor comment says the park actually closes around 20:30–21:00 rather than remaining open overnight. A June 2026 city council account confirms several park pathways and play areas had been fenced off awaiting repair. No recent cruising activity is corroborated.
